messages:
Priya Nair: Heads-up: annual expense policy refresh live now. Main highlights below — travel per diem, international card limits, and a faster PO path for security-critical vendors. Please read and flag questions.
Rajiv Kapoor: Quick Q: when does this take effect?
Priya Nair: Effective next Monday (start of fiscal week). Were publishing the full policy in Confluence: https://redwood.company/confluence/finance/expense-policy-2026
Zoe Kim: What changed for travel per diem?
Priya Nair: Per diem is now split by region (US / EMEA / APAC) and capped at $150/day US, €120/day EMEA, SGD 200/day APAC. Receipts still required for hotel and airfare; meals can use per diem.
Rajiv Kapoor: Card limits for international work trips?
Priya Nair: Temporary card single-charge limit raised to $2,500 for approved international travel. Manager must pre-approve travel in the Travel form and attach itinerary. Unapproved charges may be flagged for reimbursement delays.
Zoe Kim: Anything new for contractors / external consultants?
Priya Nair: Yes  contractors can be reimbursed but contractor reimbursements over $1,000 need pre-approval and a one-pager justification. Also mark as "contractor-expense" in the form.
LegalBot: Reminder: vendor master changes require a PO + signed MSA for third-party hosting and data access vendors. Legal review turnaround is typically 5 business days.
Priya Nair: New expedited PO path: for security-critical vendors (infra/alerting/incident response), teams can request "expedite" in procurement form. Criteria: must be tied to on-call or production incidents and have manager + eng lead sign-off. Finance will aim to triage within 48 hours. Use #procurement-emergencies for follow-up.
Zoe Kim: How does this interact with the preferred-vendor list?
Priya Nair: We're publishing a preferred-vendor list — preferred vendors with existing contracts can be onboarded in ~3 business days if docs are complete. Non-preferred vendors follow the normal flow. Link: https://redwood.company/confluence/finance/preferred-vendors
Rajiv Kapoor: Any cost-control nudges?
Priya Nair: A few: 1) Mandatory justification for new SaaS tools under $1k/mo 2) Auto-flag for duplicate subscriptions 3) Finance will run a vendor consolidation pilot for comms/monitoring tools this quarter.
FinanceBot: :bell: FYI: policy doc published and a reminder will be sent to people managers tomorrow at 09:00.
Zoe Kim: Training reimbursement?
Priya Nair: Training reimbursements remain up to $1,200/year per employee; above that requires manager + L&D approval. Submit via the Learning form.
Rajiv Kapoor: Thanks  — will update our team guidelines.
Priya Nair: Appreciated. If youd like a 15-min walkthrough for managers, sign up here: https://cal.redwood.com/finance-policy-walkthrough. DM me if urgent. :thumbsup:
